create_image_to_video_input: create an ImageToVideoInput with base64-encoded image data and optional inference parameters
build_image_to_video_parameters: build ImageToVideoParameters with guidance scale, prompt, and frame count for video generation
configure_target_size: configure ImageToVideoTargetSize with height and width in pixels for output video frames
parse_image_to_video_output: parse ImageToVideoOutput containing generated video as raw bytes from the inference response
set_inference_seed: set ImageToVideoParameters with a seed for reproducible image-to-video generation
